'''June 2003 Columbia Heights tournament (1 June)''' was a Star Wars CCG tournament held on 1 June 2003 at Twin City Comics in Columbia Heights, Minnesota, as part of the "Road to States" series before the [[2003 Minnesota State Championship]]. Twelve players took part. [[Jim Li]], back from school for the summer, won as the only undefeated player and collected a $5.00 cash bounty that had been placed on [[Michael Raveling]].<ref name="pcf-1291-28220">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=28220#28220 2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend], Nick Kolnik, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (1 June 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152912/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1291%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS4]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Twin City Comics, Columbia Heights, Minnesota<ref name="pcf-1291-28220" />
* '''Dates:''' 1 June 2003<ref name="pcf-1291-28220" />
* '''Players:''' 12<ref name="pcf-1291-28220" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Jim Li]]<ref name="pcf-1291-28220" />

The Road to States constructed tournaments were held on four Sundays before the State Championship, with cash bounties on certain players.<ref name="pcf-1291-23802">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=23802#23802 2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend], Nick Kolnik, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (10 April 2003).
